activate_mansion_switch.description: Interacts with the Mewtwo Statue directly above the player to successfully toggle the global gate state. It first presses UP to face the statue, then presses A three times with 1.5s pauses in between to open the prompt, select YES, and close the dialogue box without re-interacting or double-toggling.
activate_mansion_switch.python_script:
import json

# This tool outputs a sequence of buttons to orient UP and toggle the Mewtwo Statue switch exactly once.
# It presses 'Up' to ensure the player is facing the statue directly above,
# then 'A' to open the prompt, 'A' to select YES, and 'A' to close the final dialogue.
# This prevents double-toggles or active dialogue menu trapping.

sequence = ['Up', 'A', 'sleep 1500', 'A', 'sleep 1500', 'A']
print(json.dumps(sequence))

b1f_matrix_solver.description: Tracks and displays the gate matrix states and passability map for Pokémon Mansion B1F basement.

active_state.description: The active global gate state ('A' or 'B').

b1f_matrix_solver.python_script:
import json
import sys

input_data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
state = input_data.get('active_state', 'A').upper()

print("=== CINNABAR MANSION B1F GATE MATRIX SOLVER ===")
print(f"Active Gate State: {state}")
print("-" * 50)
print("Gate / Obstacle | Location | State A | State B | Verification")
print("-" * 50)

# West Gate
west_a = "CLOSED"
west_b = "CLOSED"
print(f"Gate B1F-West   | (1, 17)  | {west_a:<7} | {west_b:<7} | Verified CLOSED under both states.")

# Center Gate
center_a = "CLOSED"
center_b = "OPEN"
print(f"Gate B1F-Center | (13, 22) | {center_a:<7} | {center_b:<7} | Verified OPEN under State B, CLOSED under A.")

# Wall Blockage
wall_a = "CLOSED"
wall_b = "CLOSED"
print(f"Wall Blockage   | (9, 14)  | {wall_a:<7} | {wall_b:<7} | Permanent solid wall structure.")

# Gate 26/27 (East Gate)
gate26_a = "CLOSED"
gate26_b = "OPEN"
print(f"Gate 26/27      | (26, 17) | {gate26_a:<7} | {gate26_b:<7} | Open under State B (unlocks Northern section).")

print("-" * 50)
